resolution.revised_quote: L01 satisfies the historical revision 1 delay demonstration; its maximum is 118 milliseconds, below the 120-millisecond limit.

method: Read the supplied source corpus and report texts and saved each source-view before opening findings/model for that dossier.
Compared factual scope, applicable rule/exception hierarchy, chronology, quantifiers, arithmetic, evidence completeness, confidence and theorem-to-claim mapping for every listed claim.
Verified every report/evidence quote against the corresponding path/anchor segment in the immutable ingestion index.
Compared original source hashes across mixed/correct variants; all five source corpora match between variants.
Inspected relevant original DOCX XML tables and actual scan/page rasters rather than treating OCR text as self-authenticating.
Read actual Lean source and its source-to-model legend; technical statuses are reported from retained execution results, not a claim of an independent kernel implementation.
limitations: Review performed by another task agent in the same model family, with shared filesystem and verifier implementation; independence is procedural rederivation, not organizational independence.
No evaluator outcomes, source-authoring masters or example-directory contents were opened for this review.
The reviewer previously implemented infrastructure and knew the dossier06 OCR 14:38 versus14:30 issue; its visual confirmation was not a blind discovery.

The original report09 ambiguity was first flagged by its correct-run auditor, conveyed by the coordinator. This reviewer initially read the intended comparison; that limitation is explicitly recorded and the initial source-view preserved.
Source authenticity and real-world safety/authorization are outside the synthetic evidence model. Formal proofs establish the encoded propositions under reviewed premises.
The review does not certify unlimited future source changes; hashes identify the exact artifacts reviewed.

historical_reviews.review_result: No material audit/model mismatch found: C09-OK-01 is appropriately marked undetermined/disputed with arithmetic auxiliary. The original report has the separately recorded editorial ambiguity; unqualified acceptance remains withheld pending revision.
limitations: Shared model family, filesystem and verifier; not institutional or independent-kernel assurance.
Historical L01 applicability is documentarily asserted; no separate raw 24 V log is invented.

conclusion: The ten current audits faithfully preserve source-supported conclusions, explicit refutations, unresolved evidence and nonformal judgments. One genuine ambiguity in the original correct-report fixture was caught and transparently corrected; no material audit/model mismatch remains in the reviewed current snapshots.
